name: The Cursed Saga: Under Black Sails
source:
The Cursed Saga: Under Black Sails tells the story of the fate of a young French nobleman, who went in search of fame and fortune in the dangerous waters of the Caribbean. This is the era of the golden age of piracy, looting and plundering, and amazing adventures.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/PurpleGray]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《The Cursed Saga: Under Black Sails》讲述了一名年轻法国贵族的命运。他前往危险的加勒比海域，追寻名声与财富。那是海盗的黄金时代，充满了抢劫、掠夺，以及令人惊叹的冒险。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/PurpleGray]Patreon[/url]]
